resources.note: Single local Train-fold measurement; not official Test/reference-Xeon qualification.

limitations: Single fixed assignment seed and training seed.
Historically exposed Train/folds; pairwise intervals descriptive.
Finite donor occupancy changes marginal frequencies.
Intact donor quartet preserves within-context structure; target-context semantic/activation dependence is disrupted.
Donors restricted to fit-disagreement population; non-disagreement targets use this same donor population.
No new fusion, hyperparameter search or architecture controls.
